content_sections.heading: About Amrita
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is the institution issuing this recruitment, and the position sits in the Department of English at its Chennai Campus in Tamil Nadu. Its website lists campuses including Amritapuri, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi and Mysuru, with programmes from undergraduate to doctoral level.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Faculty Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: An Assistant Professor can be placed at starting level, senior grade or selection grade, depending on experience and capability.

content_sections.text: Ph.D. in English with First Class in academics throughout. Proven research track record with quality publications Passion for teaching and research Ability to engage students in interactive and participative learning Prior experience teaching B.Tech/M.Tech engineering students is preferred. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Amrita Department of English faculty job page . Use the Apply Now or Apply Online option on that page. Submit your application on or before 30 November 2026. For details about the position, write to [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. Is a Ph.D. compulsory for this faculty post?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice marks a Ph.D. in English with First Class in academics throughout as mandatory.

faq.question: Q2. Which faculty levels does the job description cover?
faq.answer: It covers Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What decides the grade of an Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Experience and capability decide whether the appointment is at starting level, senior grade or selection grade.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need experience teaching engineering students?
faq.answer: It is preferred, not mandatory. The notice asks for prior experience teaching B.Tech/M.Tech engineering students under its preferred skills.

faq.question: Q5. What research background does the university want?
faq.answer: Candidates need a proven research track record with quality publications.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the job located?
faq.answer: The post is in the Department of English at the Chennai Campus, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q7. Whom can I contact for more details?
faq.answer: The notice gives one contact for details: [email protected].
